title.zh: 卡 RE-1：NP5-01a mass_solve 设备级对照（A1-final 6 族/12 变体参考 PTX；tile 站点升级 + A-1a 裁定回写 + A0 值级旁证 B 类；PTX 不入仓）
title.en: Card RE-1: NP5-01a mass_solve device-level comparison (A1-final 6 families/12 variants; tile-site upgrades + A-1a rulings write-back + A0 value-level B-class evidence; PTX not landed)

intent.zh: 按 Chief 2026-11-11 18:00 队列与 Arch A1-final 定稿：用 refgen/a1/final 的 6 族/12 个 static 变体参考 PTX（sha/bytes 只入库，PTX 不入仓）对 mass_solve tile 站点做设备级对照并出最终分类；A-1a 裁定回写（R1 engine-semantic 认可；R2 acc:3 改判 recipe-difference + value_equivalent/analytic + MathDx opt-in 说明 + NP5-04 watch；R3 acc:0/1 由 not-decidable 升级 device 级；R4 identical 前提）；4 个 host 驱动 host-path-no-ptx；_solve_LD_sparse_fused/_factor_solve_lu_sparse_fused 记 capture-scenario-miss；A0 值级核对只作 B 类旁证；产品 PTX 离线编译（12.8.93/compute_70/lineinfo）只记 sha/bytes/命令。零 GPU、零窗；不改 src/tests/fixtures/scripts/判据/参考/容差。
intent.en: Per Chief's queue and Arch's A1-final: use the 6-family/12-static-variant reference PTX for a device-level comparison of mass_solve tile sites and produce final classifications; write back the A-1a rulings (R1 engine-semantic accepted; R2 acc:3 reclassified recipe-difference with value_equivalent/analytic + MathDx opt-in note + NP5-04 watch; R3 acc:0/1 upgraded from not-decidable to device-level; R4 identical premise); 4 host drivers host-path-no-ptx; _solve_LD_sparse_fused/_factor_solve_lu_sparse_fused capture-scenario-miss; A0 value check as B-class side evidence only; product PTX offline compile (12.8.93/compute_70/lineinfo) recorded as sha/bytes/command only. Zero GPU/window; no src/tests/fixtures/scripts or criteria changes.

acceptance: `docs/development-evidence/np-gate/np5-01a-re1/evidence.json`：A1-final 清单（6 族/12 变体 label/factory/static/entry/ptx sha256/bytes，全部来自 `refgen/a1/final/A1-final.json`）；产品 PTX 离线编译记录（12.8.93、compute_70、-lineinfo，sha/bytes/命令，PTX 不入仓）；3 个 tile 站点的设备级最终分类（含双侧指令形态与锚点）；A-1a 裁定回写 R1–R4；4 host 驱动 `not-decidable`+`host-path-no-ptx`；2 个未触发 unique 内核 `capture-scenario-miss`；A0 值级旁证（B 类、solution 残差说明）。

分类合规：只用六类词表；`recipe-difference` 带 `value_equivalent: true` + `value_equivalence_basis: "analytic, not bit-tested"`；`not-decidable` 带 6 类 `not_decidable_reasons[]`；**不写覆盖率/通过率、不写位级等价**；出现词表不适用情形（approx 与 exact 形态差异非值等价）必须写入 `requires_decision` 并标 `not-decidable`。

A-1a 裁定回写节（README + evidence）：R1 认可 engine-semantic（同一数学解、不同分解路径、位级不保证、不得当 identical）；R2 acc:3 改判 recipe-difference（字段齐全 + MathDx opt-in/默认不走/未来变默认需重评 + 不记 pin-needed、不进 deferred、NP5-04 watch）；R3 acc:0/1 保持 not-decidable 并由本卡升级 device 级；R4 identical 前提补「收缩许可、未证位级相等」。
`README.md`：范围/方法（编译-对齐-分类）/A1-final 12 变体表/产品 PTX 与参考 PTX 指令形态摘要/3 tile 站点结论与依据/待裁点/PTX 不入仓说明/非声明。
`receipt.json`：verdict=PASS、device_sites=3、a1a_rulings_recorded=true、ptx_not_landed（A1-final 12 变体 + 产品 PTX 的 sha/bytes/命令）、inputs、tree.head、gates、boundaries；`manifest.txt` 自核；UTF-8/LF/无 BOM。
`logs/selfcheck.txt`：词表/字段/理由码/待裁点/无覆盖率与通过率表述 → PASS。
边界：写域仅 `docs/development-evidence/np-gate/np5-01a-re1/**` + `.normify/**`；`unchanged src/`、`tests/`、`fixtures/`、`scripts/`；零 GPU、零窗；PTX 实体不入仓。
四门禁 fmt/clippy/clippy-cuda/unit + `normify check`；中文提交。
note: Chief 2026-11-11 18:00 队列第 5 片；Arch A1-final（np5-01a-a1-final.md 55b15ada…/5,803、A1-final.json）+ A0 值级核对（799b0ef5…）为材料；RE-1 分类不写位级等价；PTX 不入仓。
